F.name: Fast-cash productized service
F.channel: Reply to explicit buyer requests, permissioned introductions, or agency partnerships; agree scoped paid milestone.

R.name: Managed recurring monitoring
R.channel: Sell a bounded paid pilot through incumbent agencies/clients; instrument actual alerts and retention.

D.name: Self-service digital download
D.channel: Demonstrate original value in a permitted marketplace or through existing buyers; no automatic discovery assumption.

I.name: Specific app, connector or integration
I.channel: First sell integration to one authorized design partner; productize only after supported repeat requests.

M.name: Niche micro-SaaS
M.channel: Secure paid design partners before building multi-tenant software; distribution is the bottleneck.

P.name: Paid data, research or digest
P.channel: Obtain explicit rights to source data; sell one narrow paid sample to a buyer of this exact information.

A.name: Original licensed asset product
A.channel: Publish rights-clear original sample and measure actual paid conversions on approved asset storefronts.

L.name: Narrow specialist online course
L.channel: Offer a paid workshop or small lesson to people with verified need before recording a library.

C.name: Transparent affiliate/content
C.channel: Document hands-on use and disclosure; do not rely on scaled SEO or assume affiliate approval.

X.name: Two-sided niche marketplace
X.channel: Validate supply and demand with actual transacting buyers before writing marketplace infrastructure.
